Alex: Heads-up — PR #2379 needs a tiny rename nit fixed before we can merge to main. It's blocking the hotfix deploy tonight. I left a suggested change in the PR comment.

Jin: On it. Quick question: are we ok switching the function name from `serveBatch` -> `serve_batches` (snake) or should it be camelCase `serveBatches` to match the runtime helpers?

Maria: prefer `serveBatches` to match runtime naming conventions. Also update the unit tests that reference the old name.

Jin: OK will push. FYI I added a short migration note in the PR description and ran a local grep to update callsites.

Alex: SG. Can you paste the small change here so I can eyeball it quickly? If it's straightforward I'll merge and trigger the hotfix pipeline. @maria any objections?

Jin: Pushed patch now. PTAL:
```
- func serveBatch(ctx, req) {
+ func serveBatches(ctx, reqs) {
  // adjusted to accept slices, kept compatibility shim
}
```

Maria: lgtm, tests updated. Also added a comment in lint config to ignore `serveBatch` deprecation for one release.

ci-bot: ci-bot: queued job #987 for PR 2379

Alex: Thanks — approved and I'll merge in ~10m if CI green. If anything fails we can rollback the cherry-pick from release/1.2-hotfix.

ci-bot: ci-bot: job #987 succeeded ✅

Alex: Merged and cherry-picked to release/1.2-hotfix. Deploy scheduled for 20:00 UTC. :rocket:

Maria: Nice — thanks all :thumbsup:
